parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: A personal access token. This parameter is optional if you authenticate with an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or temporary credentials from Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: checkRunId
parameters.description: The ID of the check run.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. You can get this ID from your Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The repository ID or full path.
